import sys
from collections import deque

def solve():
    input = sys.stdin.readline
    N, M = map(int, input().split())
    S = input().strip()
    T = input().strip()
    Q = int(input())
    queries = [tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(Q)]
    
    # visited timestamp
    vis = [[0]*(M+1) for _ in range(N+1)]
    cur_time = 0
    
    out_lines = []
    for a,b,c,d in queries:
        cur_time += 1
        # next unvisited per row/col
        nr = [0]*(N+1)
        nc = [0]*(M+1)
        dq = deque()
        vis[a][b] = cur_time
        dist = 0
        dq.append((a,b,0))
        ans = -1
        while dq:
            i,j,dd = dq.popleft()
            if i==c and j==d:
                ans = dd
                break
            # row expansion
            if S[i]=='>':
                start = max(j, nr[i])
                for j2 in range(start, M+1):
                    if vis[i][j2] != cur_time:
                        vis[i][j2] = cur_time
                        dq.append((i,j2,dd+1))
                    nr[i] = j2+1
            else: # '<'
                start = min(j, nr[i] if nr[i]<=j else j)
                # iterate downwards
                j2 = j
                while j2 >= 0:
                    if vis[i][j2] != cur_time:
                        vis[i][j2] = cur_time
                        dq.append((i,j2,dd+1))
                    j2 -= 1
                nr[i] = 0  # all visited in this row
            # column expansion
            if T[j]=='v':
                start = max(i, nc[j])
                for i2 in range(start, N+1):
                    if vis[i2][j] != cur_time:
                        vis[i2][j] = cur_time
                        dq.append((i2,j,dd+1))
                    nc[j] = i2+1
            else: # '^'
                i2 = i
                while i2 >= 0:
                    if vis[i2][j] != cur_time:
                        vis[i2][j] = cur_time
                        dq.append((i2,j,dd+1))
                    i2 -= 1
                nc[j] = 0
        out_lines.append(str(ans))
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out_lines))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
